profile.summary: Miosss is a mid-level JavaScript developer with specialized expertise in Chart.js, demonstrating strong skills in core JavaScript array handling, conditional logic, and charting-specific rendering logic. Their contributions focus on fixing subtle bugs (e.g., silent failures in Bezier curve calculations), extending library APIs (e.g., adding new tooltip alignment options), and implementing flexible templating systems. While primarily frontend-focused, their problem-solving approach and attention to edge cases suggest potential for growth in testing and advanced Git workflows.
skill_evidence: Fixed incorrect array indexing for single-point datasets in Bezier curve calculations (PR #1, #2)
Added `if` conditions to prevent silent failures in rendering logic (PR #1, #2)
Introduced `multiTooltipTextAlign` option with default values and alternative alignment (PR #5)
Modified scale templating to allow user choice between processing functions and micro-templating (PR #3)
Added function to remove entire datasets, affecting chart updates and data binding (PR #4)
Acknowledged learning Git/GitHub workflows in PR description (PR #1)
Made modular, focused changes without large-scale refactoring (all PRs)
